_cases: Parses per process. The three gate cases that split before tree objects were constructor-built (#224, #230), whose fixture builders copy what they keep; and four whose trees keep parseman's own objects: a CST host (cstBuildHost nodes over parseman leaves and spans), builder-less default nodes without and with line tracking, and a builder that keeps the span parseman passes it. graphql/document keeps its grammar's OWN nodes (examples/graphql/graphql-node.js), and it must stay in the fast mode too.
_pads: Bytes of never-called code appended to dist/index.js. 970 bytes was enough to move Jess's .jess parser from 0 of 16 to 8 of 16 slow processes on Node 24.
_maxMarkCompacts: Per process. The fast mode runs 1-2 mark-compacts on these counts. A pretenured process ran 15-61, and a partly pretenured lines/doc process 5, so 3 leaves a step either side. Fast-mode counts depend on heap sizing: a smaller machine may read 3-4 in the fast mode. Read the calibration line the check prints at pad 0 before trusting a failure, and raise this per machine rather than in this file.
